passages.provision_quote: A proposed housing development containing no more than two residential units within a single-family residential zone shall be considered ministerially, without discretionary review or a hearing, if the proposed housing development meets all of the following requirements:
passages.note: Bill text's core provision requires ministerial approval of duplexes in single-family zones and bars local agencies from imposing standards that would preclude that construction, cutting zoning limits rather than creating subsidies or public housing.
Senate floor vote record shows Umberg among the Ayes on SB 9's final concurrence vote, 28-7.

rows.reasoning: SB 9 (2021-2022) requires ministerial approval of housing developments of no more than two units in single-family zones and bars local agencies from imposing standards that would preclude such construction, cutting zoning limits that block private building without creating subsidies, public housing, or rent caps, matching rung 5, 'Rely on the market to set prices and supply — at most, cut the regulations and zoning limits that block private building.' Umberg is recorded among the Ayes on both the Senate floor vote and the final concurrence vote on this single-subject bill.
